findings.problem: The Shu embassy is an undated 先是 flashback, yet it is dated 326 or, for Li Xiong, 326–334.
findings.action: Keep 先是 and the separate 咸和初 notice. Drop the closed 326 year and Li Xiong’s imported 334 death end.

findings.problem: Xin Tao, Zhang Xuan, and Dong Guang share s0228 with dated colleagues but were left undated with empty hints.
findings.action: Give them the same 湣帝崩問 / 建興六年 cluster context as the rest of the column. Do not invent Jianwu 1.

findings.problem: Most personal events in s0422–s0628 are narrated without a new era year after 咸和初, 太興二年, 咸和八年/九年, 永和元年, and 永和二年. The extraction still assigns closed Xianhe 5, Xiankang 1/4/6, Yonghe 3/5/6/8, and similar Western years from an external Jin table.
findings.action: For each owned claim, keep the Chinese event and strip invented sourceDate/westernInterval pairs. Where the narrative only follows an earlier year-header, either leave the date unresolved with a substantive reason or use a one-sided westernBounds tied to the last explicit header (onOrAfter that conventional year). Synchronize hints to the repaired personal events only.

findings.problem: s0449 says 咸和初, not 咸和元年–三年. Liu Yao’s death by Shi Le is undated. Several Liu Yao/Han Pu/Xin Yan evidence lists cite palace-colour units s0445/s0447 (西曰政刑白殿; 其傍皆有直省內官寺署) that do not name those men.
findings.action: Retarget evidence to s0449–s0452. Preserve 咸和初 as the source date; convert only the 咸和 label (Cheng of Jin, first year AD 326) without closing a 326–328 reign or rewriting 初 as exact Xianhe 1. Remove the invented Xianhe-3 end.

findings.problem: Evidence IDs are misaligned with the Chinese: Liu Yao/Han Pu/Xin Yan cite palace units s0445/s0447; Yang Xuan cites s0431 號曰積賢君 instead of s0434 楊宣率眾越流沙.
findings.action: Replace evidence with the units that actually name the person (s0449–s0452; s0434). Do not trust English translations where they drift from the Chinese.

findings.problem: Speeches cite 西門豹, 解扁, 文侯, 周穆王, 光武/世祖, 樂毅, 騎劫, 韓信, 穰苴, 呂蒙, 魏延, 耿弇, 黃權, 方邵, 慕容皝, 漢高, and 王陵. Those are later references, not dated life events of the named persons. The extraction assigned external life/reign years and copied them into active hints.
findings.action: Reclassify each as retrospective-reference or receptionType: retrospective on the citation. Keep the citation as its own event with the host speech’s date context if any. Clear life-date hints. Do not infer death from retrospective use.

findings.problem: s0493 駿在位二十二年卒，時年四十 and 穆帝追諡, s0498 父卒時年十六, and s0629 將受詔未及而卒時年二十七 are omitted as death/age/reception. Living-rule claims instead use Taining 2–Yonghe 2 or Yonghe 1/2–Yonghe 9. Yonghe 9 is not in the Chinese; 在位十一年 (s0630) and the two ages conflict with a 353 end. s0623 懷恨九泉 and later 文王/明王 honors are posthumous reception used as life dates.
findings.action: Add death and age claims for Zhang Jun (age 40; 22 years in power) and Zhang Chonghua (age 16 at father’s death; died at 27) without converting ages into birth years. Keep 穆帝追諡 and 九泉/追崇 as reception events dated from their own passages. Rebuild living windows only from 永和元年 appointment, 永和二年 accession, and unresolved or bounded death after the last living acts. Drop Yonghe 9 and unsourced Taining 2.

findings.problem: Geng Fang’s sourced chain is 建興中 / 太興二年 / 七年 / 咸和八年 / 九年. The claim starts at Taixing 2 and ends at Xianhe 8. Jia Ling’s sending is dated with the arrival year. Wang Feng’s 333-only hint drops 九年復使訪隨豐等.
findings.action: Split Geng Fang into separate dated events for 建興中, 太興二年 (AD 319), the seven-year stay, 咸和八年 arrival (AD 333), and 九年. Date Jia Ling’s dispatch as pre-arrival and the arrival as Xianhe 8. Extend Wang Feng’s active hint to include the year-9 mission or record that mission as its own event.

findings.problem: Shi Le and Li Xiong are dated from undated frontier diplomacy or from 勒雄既死 in a later memorial. Shi Hu is given Xianhe 9–Yonghe 5 or Yonghe 3–5 including undated 季龍自斃. Those are reign windows and retrospective death notices, not sourced living endpoints.
findings.action: Keep each named act (殺劉曜, 分境, 稱臣, 既死, 自斃) as its own event. Mark years unresolved unless a nearby explicit era year governs that sentence. Do not use 既死/自斃 as living active hints or as exact Western death years.

findings.problem: Emperor Mu’s 賜諡 and Xiaowu’s 賜諡 are undated later honors; the extraction dated each emperor’s entire reign as if that were the event.
findings.action: Date each 賜諡 as a reception/honor with unresolved year or a bound inside that emperor’s reign. Remove the reign-span attestation and the matching active hints.

findings.problem: Zhang Gui, Zhang Shi, Zhang Mao and Zhang Jun appear in these units only as later praise, 追崇 king-titles, 故太尉, kinship tags, or historian’s appraisal. Their reign years were imported as living activity.
findings.action: Keep the reception/identification. Move Gui/Shi/Mao honors to retrospective reception dated to Heping 1 / Yonghe 10 (s0655) or to the post-淮肥 edict (s0808). Do not attach Yonghe 2 to s0749. Clear the 301–314 / 314–320 / 320–324 / 346 hints.

findings.problem: Yaoling’s succession/murder, Lady Ma’s deposition, Zuo’s first seizure, and Zhao Chang/Wei Ji’s early pact stand before 永和十年, yet were given an exact Yonghe 9 / AD 353 year. Zuo was also given a 353–355 reign window. p303 dates a later kinship heading as if Yaoling were still alive.
findings.action: Use onOrBefore Yonghe 10 / AD 354 (s0842) or unresolved:true. Do not invent AD 353. Add Yaoling’s age 十歲 and death 害耀靈. Treat s0697 as retrospective. Split Zuo’s undated seizure from the Yonghe 10 imperial claim.

findings.problem: Reign-length or house-duration notices (篡立三年, 在位九年, 即位十三年, 七十六年) and imported ruler tables were turned into activity windows. Tianxi’s end ‘Yixi 2’ / 406 is not in Jinshu and conflicts with a 338–398 reading. Fu Jian’s 357–385 reign is not narrated here.
findings.action: Split accession and death. Keep 三年/九年/十三年 as reign length, not Gregorian spans. For Tianxi’s death use 尋卒，年六十一 after 桓玄時 with unresolved year or competing 406/398 bounds; do not certify 406. Fu Jian: date only 太和初, 太元元年, and 淮肥.

findings.problem: After 建興四十三年 the narrative (Li Yan, Wei Shen 經年, Tian Xuan/Ma Ji, Quan’s fall, Hun’s regency) has no year labels. The extraction invented Yonghe 11, Yonghe 12, and Shengping 3 and extended Hun to Shengping 5 after 混卒.
findings.action: Mark those stretches unresolved, or bound them after Jianxing 43 / AD 355 and before Jianxing 49 / Shengping (s0740). Honor 經年. Add Hun’s death and the executions of Tian Xuan, Ma Ji 馬基, and Quan’s destruction. Delete Shengping 3.

findings.problem: The Yong–Tianxi palace struggle and the later 初 adoption flashback were all labelled Shengping 5, a year that appears only when s0740 奉升平之號 after Yong is already dead. Ages 十八九 were omitted.
findings.action: Date the era change at s0740 as Jianxing 49 / Shengping / AD 361. Leave the preceding killings and the 初 adoption unresolved or onOrBefore that change. Add Song Cheng’s killing, Yong’s suicide, and Guo Zeng/Liu Su’s ages without converting them to birth years.

findings.problem: Suo Shang’s remonstrance sits after 太和初, not in Xingning 2 / AD 364.
findings.action: Move the date into the 太和初 block (conventional AD 366 opening) or leave unresolved relative to s0753. Delete the Xingning 2 hint.

findings.problem: The Huan Wen alliance embassy (s0778–s0785) has no Xianan 1.
findings.action: Set unresolved:true on the embassy, or bound it after 時苻堅強盛 and before 太元元年. Delete AD 371 hints.

findings.problem: Sun Quan, Meng Ming, Yu, the Duke of Zhou, Zhi Yu and Hou Jin are later citations or historian’s appraisal. Exact years (222–252, 627 BC, 2100 BC, 1042 BC, 301, 170) are not in the Chinese.
findings.action: Classify as retrospective-reference or receptionType:retrospective. Leave dates unresolved. Do not assign living-activity hints. Do not infer death from retrospective.

findings.problem: s0805 dates Fu Rong by 淮肥, not Taiyuan 8. Zizhi Tongjian vol. 105 places that battle in Taiyuan 8 / AD 383, but the claim’s sourceDate pretends Jinshu wrote the era year.
findings.action: Set sourceDate to 淮肥/淝水 and convert with the Tongjian witness. Do not keep ‘Taiyuan 8’ as if it were a Jinshu label.

findings.problem: 道子嘗問 is one undated remark; 隆安中 is an era-middle label; 桓玄時 is a period label. These were expanded into Daozi 385–402, Yuanxian 398–402, and Huan Xuan 402–404.
findings.action: Keep 隆安中 as during Long’an (AD 397–401) without inventing Long’an 2 or Yuanxing 1. Leave 嘗問 and 桓玄時 unresolved or one-sided after Tianxi’s return. Delete career-span hints.

findings.problem: Owned Chinese states deaths, killings, or ages that were never extracted as death/age claims (Yaoling 十歲/害耀靈; Zuo 被殺; Taihe/Tingjian 誅祚二子; Ding Qi 斬; Lady Ma 卒; Xuanjing 年十四; Wang Luan/Suo Fu; Hun 卒; Tian Xuan/Ma Ji 斬; Cheng/Yong; Qin 伏法; Tianxi 年六十一; Chang Ju/Xi Le/Zhao Chongzhe/Shi Jing 戰死).
findings.action: Add death (and age where written) on the existing person IDs and source units. Preserve 歲 as age. Do not compute birth years. Keep later reception (私諡, 追贈) as separate events.
